nature_language: [当前位置上海,目标位置广州,旅行人数1,旅行天数2] 本周将会前往广州出差，停留两天，请为我规划一下出行的交通和出行的日期，需求是：在交通方式不受天气影响的条件下时间越短越好。
nature_language_en: [Current location: Shanghai, Destination: Guangzhou, Number of travelers: 1, Travel days: 2] I will be going on a business trip to Guangzhou this week, staying for two days. Please help me plan the travel transportation and dates. The requirement is: under the condition that the mode of transportation is not affected by the weather, the shorter the travel time, the better.
